integrity: The unbounded assertions have a complete Gaussian moment and adjacent-weight induction proof. A standalone exact integer verifier checks all 4094 characters for n=1..11 and the formula/recurrences up to n=60. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unrestricted labelled symmetric-group involutions only; multiplicity-weighted exact fixed-point position sets, not edge-incidence or descent profiles. The central-moment integer sequence is known independently (OEIS A053871); its new role is the sharp Walsh gap. No endpoint inverse bound or broader group classification is claimed.
title: Fourier sign rigidity and sharp recovery gaps for involution fixed-point profiles
